Catalogue 'Wilkinson' maker mark not clearly read in my crops, but the 1907/crown/date stamps support the pattern. Japanese-looking marks suggest possible Japanese-made or contract example, which is of collector interest.

reason: 1907 pattern bayonet dated Feb 1915 with scabbard, collectable militaria
